newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ridgeview started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ridgeview started as buy.

text.p: -- Interstate/Johnson Lane said it initiated coverage of Ridgeview Inc with a buy rating and gave the stock a price target of $12 a share.
-- The stock rose 1/4 to 7-3/4 in light volume on Monday.
-- Analyst Kay Norwood said in a research report the Newton, North Carolina company was given the rating based on higher-risk capital gains accounts.

-- Norwood said the company is diversified by product, customer and geography, is substantially modern, and has a balance sheet that should permit future growth as a result of its November 1 initial public offering.
-- The stock went public at $8 a share. Interstate/Johnson Lane was the lead underwriter of the offering.
-- The company manufactures sports socks and hosiery.
